questions.question: Which spelling is correct?
questions.explanation: Correct: audible. This word ends in ible and begins with audi, meaning hearing or sound. Audable uses the more common able ending but breaks the established word family. Transfer: connect audible with audio to secure the first part, then remember the ible ending.

questions.explanation: Correct: eligible. It begins with a single l sound after e and ends in ible. Elligible adds an unsupported extra l, while eligable uses the wrong ending. Transfer: split it into four beats—el-i-gi-ble—and check each one.
